Name: Better Elevator - Continued
Author: FlyingTNT
Description:
This is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12802]Better Elevator[/url] by aedenthorn.

This mod lets you use the stairs in the Mine and Skull Cavern like the elevator, except you can input the exact floor you want to go to.

To use the mod, hold down the modifier key (default Left Shift) while clicking on the main stairs in a mine level, the door in Skull Cave, or the stairs in the mine entrance. This will open a small menu in which you can input a mine number via the keyboard. Press Enter to travel to the typed floor. Press Backspace to delete a digit.

By default the mod restricts travel to floors you've visited, but you can remove this limit in the config.


[size=5]Technical[/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods[/url].
